additional_info.subject: RE: ID0440427-DC/Si-D/HU-[MP / S3 170003431]CCS plug issue CRM:02681000535
additional_info.body:
Hello Norbert,
Hope you are doing well.
We are currently analyzing the logs and will get back to you shortly with an update. As you mentioned that the necessary checks were already performed during the site visit, also could you please confirm the following points related to the visual inspection:
1. Dirt on CCS pins
2. Water ingress on CCS plug
3. corrosion of connector blades
Additionally, t
he charger is showing in the old version v3.2.8, so we can get significant improvements by updating the charger to the latest update. After upgrading the latest one, we will analyze whether the problem still exists or not.
So, could you please ask the customer if it can be update with the latest firmware version and if yes then let us know the date and time so that we can proceed further to upgrade it.
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
